track: M34 emulator orchestration and zero-regression efficiency
goal: Reduce duplicated startup, artifact IO and wasted serial emulator wall time while preserving or strengthening every existing quality gate.

milestones.name: Reuse one hash-verified APK across emulator devices
milestones.acceptance: Check one Android APK build job, one SHA-256 propagated to every emulator and independent aggregator.

milestones.name: Use all four independent emulator runners without a three-worker queue
milestones.acceptance: Matrix has exactly four roles, max-parallel four, immutable artifact from one builder.

milestones.name: Unify duplicate advanced-review job setup and downloads
milestones.acceptance: Both independent review algorithms run even if either fails, one image download and pip install, preserve historical artifact identities.

milestones.name: Reject Android launch screens in ALL emulator screenshots
milestones.acceptance: Explicit GLES sky background + nonempty geometry + system modal rejection, genuine 14 angles.

milestones.name: Enforce fail-closed evidence without weakening artistic gates
milestones.acceptance: Missing emulator, launcher capture, wrong SHA, missing view, failed visual reviewer always fails evidence gate.

milestones.name: Impact-aware changed-asset scheduling
milestones.acceptance: Only skip costly Android test for provably unrelated docs/source, full Android on scene/renderer/material/mesh changes; maintain a separate source QA job.
milestones.implementation_note: Six-team high-detail production now triggers only on its actual geometry/manager/export source, not every unrelated veilforge file. Full impact-based factory/emulator routing remains planned.

milestones.name: Optimize emulator boot and AVD image caching
milestones.acceptance: Prove reduced boot duration in repeated Actions runs; key cache by API/device/runner; invalidate corrupted or stale AVD, cold boot fallback.

milestones.name: Bound incremental logcat streaming and capture retries
milestones.acceptance: One process or bounded append-only log cursor per device, no repeated entire log buffer retrieval, no missed GPU error/frame markers.

milestones.name: Measure real CI runtime and artifact size
milestones.acceptance: Collect before/after job times, APK size and capture bytes over >=3 comparable clean runs, no invented speed percentages.

milestones.name: Shared single emulator QA SDK for M30, factory and unified queue
milestones.acceptance: One tested ADB, screenshot, image and log validator API; compatibility tests for existing reviewers.

milestones.name: Targeted source health audit and orphan-code investigation
milestones.acceptance: Reachable import and workflow references across all engine/test entrypoints, never delete externally referenced code or game sources.

milestones.name: Hardware performance and memory regression budgets
milestones.acceptance: Actual target hardware measurements of GPU frame time, memory and artifact loading with P95 budgets.

milestones.name: Final visual regression and asset release approval
milestones.acceptance: Actual source 14 views, four verified Android roles as applicable, separate artist reference signoff and no automatic game promotion.

claims_limit: Parallelism reduces a three-plus-one emulator wave to one wave when runners are available. Do not claim a specific wall-time or cost improvement until comparable real Actions jobs prove it.
definition_of_done: All P0/P1 gates have independent green CI evidence, compatible Android captures remain genuine and the changes have not removed model/visual/hardware release gates. Exact photorealism and physical-device acceptance remain outside this optimization track.
base_run_status: Initial CI found missing Pillow dependencies in both manager jobs and an older mock missing new captured-frame field; corrected in this milestone before rerun.
